releases.notes:
Private notifications from Codex CLI, Claude Code, and local scripts inside Minecraft Java Edition on Fabric. Notifications are shown only on your client and never sent to server chat.

## New in 0.3.0
- **Minecraft 26.3 support.** Needs Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API 0.164.0+26.3.
- **Vanilla-style popups.** Purple tooltip frame, bell icon, and Minecraft text colours.
- **Smaller popups.** Cards size to their text, 160–220 GUI pixels wide like vanilla toasts, so they take less space at large GUI scales.

## Which file?
| Minecraft | Download | Java |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 26.3 | `minenotify-0.3.0-mc26.3.zip` | 25+ |
| 26.2 | `minenotify-0.3.0-mc26.2.zip` | 25+ |
| 1.21.1 | `minenotify-0.3.0-mc1.21.1.zip` | 21+ |

Each ZIP has the mod JAR, the Python bridge (`tools/notify.py`, `tools/setup.py`), and setup docs. The bare JARs are attached for launchers where you only want the mod. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions) separately. Follow the [README](https://github.com/arogan178/minenotify#install-and-test) to connect Codex CLI or Claude Code.

Upgrading from 0.2.0: replace the mod JAR. Settings and 0.2.0 Python helpers keep working.

Verify downloads against `minenotify-0.3.0-SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Verification
CI builds and checks all three versions on Linux, Windows, and macOS. 26.3 was tested in-game in Prism Launcher on Linux. The new popups have not been checked in-game on 1.21.1 or 26.2.

This project was developed with substantial AI assistance.
